cache_and_multimodal_note.host_ram_cache_lead: The pinned GLM TP2 release describes an LMCache RAM tier and reports a cache-workload prior; it is not quality or local performance evidence.
cache_and_multimodal_note.launcher_readme_contradiction: Pinned runtime README claims GLM image/video-bearing cache bundles with content-hash placeholders, but the launcher warns an LMCache recurrent connector restores text only and uses native GPU prefix caching for image/video. Treat executable launcher behavior as the boundary until image-pinned E2E restore evidence exists.
cache_and_multimodal_note.vram_only_relevance: CACHE_MODE=vram starts no external cache service, so it does not invoke CPU/disk recurrent restore; vision still requires qualification.
